import sqlite3, datetime
con = sqlite3.connect('/tmp/chrome_history_copy.sqlite')
cur = con.cursor()
# Chrome epoch: microseconds since 1601-01-01
def chrome_ts(s):
    # unix seconds -> chrome
    return int((s + 11644473600) * 1_000_000)
start = chrome_ts(datetime.datetime(2026,8,23,2,41,0,tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp())
end = chrome_ts(datetime.datetime(2026,8,23,2,43,0,tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp())
print("WINDOW")
for row in cur.execute("SELECT last_visit_time, url, title FROM urls WHERE last_visit_time BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY last_visit_time", (start, end)):
    ts = datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(row[0]/1e6 - 11644473600)
    print(ts.isoformat(), row[1][:180], "|", (row[2] or "")[:80])
print("RECENT CHAT")
for row in cur.execute("SELECT last_visit_time, url, title FROM urls WHERE url LIKE '%chat.google%' ORDER BY last_visit_time DESC LIMIT 20"):
    ts = datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(row[0]/1e6 - 11644473600)
    print(ts.isoformat(), row[1][:180], "|", (row[2] or "")[:80])
print("VISITS IN WINDOW")
for row in cur.execute("SELECT visit_time, url FROM visits v JOIN urls u ON v.url=u.id WHERE visit_time BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY visit_time", (start, end)):
    ts = datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(row[0]/1e6 - 11644473600)
    print(ts.isoformat(), row[1][:180])
